source: P9-R1 Infrastructure Readiness Remediation report (2026-10-24), section 28

findings.description: The backup did not include workflow, policy, CRM, management or manufacturing tables
Preview builds inherited production credentials and could reach the production database
Production has no backup at all (Supabase Free, backup passphrase not set)
Production v2.33 runs dependency versions with published advisories (Next.js image-optimizer RCE, server-action DoS; mail parsers)
Public sign-up is enabled in the Supabase projects (the application signs out and logs uninvited accounts)
The repository is public; making it private needs an uptime-schedule decision first
Vercel Hobby: runtime logs kept 1 hour; plan meant for non-commercial use
The nine approval policies are unapproved seeded defaults
No hosted validation yet: staging security, performance, 24-hour endurance, restore, real users, real devices, production-copy rehearsal
Webhooks, collaborators and deploy keys of the repository cannot be read with the development access
The operations alert step of the Uptime workflow runs only once it is on the main branch
